description:
FOUND s492c (Opus, 2026-09-21) while attributing a sweep mover: task #2101
made `$?` real, and perl-tests/ref.t:530 -- `is($?, 0, 'UNIVERSAL::AUTOLOAD
called when freeing qr//')` -- stopped passing on a stale 0 and started
reporting its child's REAL exit status, 255.

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs ./runpcl):

    sub UNIVERSAL::AUTOLOAD { qr// } a->p

    perl: exits 0 (the AUTOLOAD in UNIVERSAL is found for the missing method)
    PCL:  dies "Can't locate object method \"p\" via package \"a\" (perhaps you
          forgot to load \"a\"?) at - line 1." and exits 2 (255 through the
          harness)

perl's method resolution, on a miss, walks @ISA for `AUTOLOAD` and then falls
back to `UNIVERSAL::AUTOLOAD`.  PCL's plain-call path DOES consult AUTOLOAD
(`%p-call-of-undefined-sub`, task #432), and the METHOD path consults a
class's own/inherited AUTOLOAD -- what is missing is the UNIVERSAL fallback,
which is the last step of the same walk.

It is a small, bounded addition to the method-miss path, and the acceptance
is the ref.t row above (which is now a blessed failure with #2101 as its
attributing cause, so fixing this takes it back out BY EDIT).
subject: A package-level `UNIVERSAL::AUTOLOAD` is not consulted on a METHOD MISS -- `sub UNIVERSAL::AUTOLOAD {...} a->p` dies "Can't locate object method" where perl calls the AUTOLOAD
